answer: Every claim climbs the quill of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the marble re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on asynchronous consensus epochs backed by multi-party quorum signatures. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the whisper of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a pragmatic engineering phrasing, concise declarative statements register, it stays short.
